Spec: sidebar groups a workspace by its work in progress — UI atlas

Spec: sidebar groups a workspace by its work in progress — UI atlas

5 views with 17 states. Mocked: Sidebar, Placement options. The remaining areas are listed from the map and are not designed yet.

Illustrative only. Low-fi wireframes on the app’s tokens: they decide anatomy, states and copy intent, not the final look. All names and data are fictional. Card text is rendered from the cards files and the view list from spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-map.md: change the markdown and regenerate. Link to a view or a state by id: #A1, #A1-s2.

Compared with today’s app

Paseo FSH fork fsh at ae781d529 (2026-11-25), with Overview's In progress section (#237) and paseo-asks inProgress entries (#91).

The sidebar today:

  • Groups, top to bottom: Needs input, Failed, Ready to review, Working, Done, Blocked. An idle workspace goes to Ready to review when its last turn finished, unless a plugin report moves it: paseo-status's card (Working, Blocked, Done; a Working card counts only while something ran in the last 5 minutes) or paseo-asks' open asks (needs you → Ready to review).
  • Workspace row: title, project, and a line of badges: "needs you (3)" from open asks, plugin badges, the time since last activity. A spinning ring while running.
  • In-progress asks count nowhere in the sidebar; only Overview's In progress section lists them.

3 new, 2 changed views. Inside frames, while Changes is on: new changed removed (removed parts show only then).

Decisions (stage 1, 2026-11-25)

  1. Group by what the in-progress work waits on (A27): on machines (CI checks running, a live background job, a running turn) → Working; only on a person other than you (a requested review) → Blocked. Mixed → Working, as the existing fold ranks working work above blocked. V1 and V2 are both kept, each for its case; V3 is dropped.
  2. A workspace with in-progress work that nothing moves stays in Ready to review, with a warning badge "N not moving" (A28).
  3. The "N in progress" badge shows only where in-progress work explains the row's group (under Working or Blocked because of it); "N not moving" shows wherever it applies (A29).
  4. Moving in-progress work wins over a Done status card: the row stays under Working or Blocked until the work finishes or is handed back (A30).
  5. Stage 1 approved (A31).

Sidebar — area rules

source: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-sidebar.md

Area-wide

  • Who. The operator scanning 10–30 workspaces to pick the next one that needs them.
  • Device. Desktop sidebar, ~300 px; the mobile drawer shows the same groups and rows.
  • Moving. As on Overview: an in-progress item moves while its agent's turn runs, a live background job runs, or it watches an open PR; otherwise, after 10 minutes, it is "not moving" (Overview A8, A19).
  • Precedence, first match wins, for an idle workspace: a permission (Needs input) or a failure (Failed), as today → an open ask, or in-progress work where stuck items are at least as many as moving ones (Ready to review) → moving work on machines (Working) → work waiting only on a reviewer (Blocked) → the status card's report → the finished turn.
  • Permissions. None.

Decisions (cards, 2026-11-25)

  1. A row under Blocked because of a requested review says "awaiting review" ("2 awaiting review" for several); rows under Working keep "N in progress" (A33).
  2. A row under Working because of in-progress work shows a still dot, not the spinning ring (A34).
  3. Moving majority wins: with more items moving than stuck, the row stays under Working or Blocked and shows "N not moving"; with stuck items at least as many as moving ones, it goes to Ready to review (A35).
  4. Stage 2 approved (A36).

S1 Sidebar groups

changedP16 states · Desktop sidebar · 300card text: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-sidebar.md

Short

Where an idle workspace lands now that its in-progress work counts.

Change

Changed — in-progress work now decides the group of an idle workspace: moving on machines → Working, waiting only on a reviewer → Blocked, not moving → Ready to review; a Done card no longer wins over moving work.

Extended

Groups and their order are unchanged. An idle workspace whose open items are all in progress joins Working while any of them waits on machines (CI checks running, a live background job, a running turn), and Blocked when all of them wait on a requested review (A27). Items not moving put it in Ready to review (A28), unless more of its items are moving than stuck: then it stays under Working or Blocked and the row says "1 not moving" (A35). A Done status card loses to moving work (A30). When the last in-progress item finishes, the workspace falls back to today's rules.

Get here

The sidebar.

Shows

The usual groups; rows that moved because of in-progress work carry the S2 badge.

Scenarios

Back from lunch: Ready to review holds only "Track: Search" (an ask for you) and "Track: Catalog" (2 not moving); Billing's merge train sits under Working, the schema PR waiting on a reviewer under Blocked.

Variants

CI running (Working); review only (Blocked); CI and review mixed (Working); one item not moving among three moving (stays under Working, "1 not moving"); Done card with moving asks (Working); all items finished (back to Ready to review or Done by today's rules).

Edge cases

The agent starts a turn → Working with the spinning ring, as today. An open ask arrives → Ready to review with "needs you (1)". A row moved by hand (Move to Done) stays until a newer status or a turn, as today.

S2 Workspace row

changedP15 states · Desktop sidebar · 300card text: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-sidebar.md

Short

The row's badge line says why in-progress work put it where it is.

Change

Changed — a muted "3 in progress" badge is new on rows that sit under Working or Blocked because of in-progress work; a warning "2 not moving" badge is new wherever some work is stuck.

Extended

Badges in order: "needs you (N)" (unchanged), "N not moving" (warning tone, alert icon), "N in progress" (muted, dashed-circle icon). "N in progress" shows only when in-progress work is the reason for the row's group (A29): not on a row that is under Working because its agent runs a turn. A row under Working because of in-progress work shows a still dot on its avatar instead of the spinning ring: nothing of its own runs a turn.

Get here

Any workspace row.

Shows

Avatar with state dot, title, project, badges, time since last activity.

Variants

Working via in-progress work ("3 in progress", still dot); Blocked on a review ("awaiting review"); Ready to review with "needs you (1)" and "2 not moving"; Working because the agent runs (no in-progress badge, spinning ring).

Edge cases

A narrow sidebar truncates the title before any badge; badges never wrap to a third line.

Placement options — area rules

source: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Area-wide

  • Purpose. Compare three groups for an idle workspace whose open work is all in progress and moving. Every option is drawn on the same sidebar, so frames with the same state id compare directly.
  • Sidebar. Seven workspaces in one project: "Fix login redirect" (an agent asks a permission → Needs input), "Track: Billing pages" (the one in question: turn ended, 3 asks wait on CI and review, a merge queue runs, nothing waits on you), "Track: Search" (asks you to name a tab → Ready to review), "Docs: release notes" (agent running → Working), "Track: Catalog" (5 asks in progress, 2 with nothing moving them), "Upgrade Expo" (Done), "Schema: relations" (Blocked on another workspace).
  • Device. Desktop sidebar, ~300 px wide, light theme as in the Overview atlas.
  • Rows. As today: status ring or dot, title, project, a badge line ("needs you (2)") and the time since last activity.
  • Permissions. None.

V3 Stays in Ready to review

Short
